name: Hirohara Yukiko
source:
A lively girl [spoiler] who is later seen killing monsters mercilessly during the Red Night[/spoiler]. She is a granddaughter of the Hirohara Zaibatsu, one of the richest houses in the 11eyes world.[spoiler] She came back to Japan from the nation Dransvania. Her primary power of regeneration makes her almost immortal. She fights using two knives. Her positive personality is maintained by a self-hypnotic suggestion while she is wearing her glasses. When the glasses are removed, her eyes and personality turn into that of a killing machine.[/spoiler] She is one year younger than [url=https://vndb.org/c3122]Yuka[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c3121]Kakeru[/url].

[spoiler]She's the younger cousin of [url=https://vndb.org/c16303]Tsukiko Hirohara[/url], who she admires greatly.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/11eyes:_Tsumi_to_Batsu_to_Aganai_no_Sh%C5%8Djo]Wikipedia[/url]]
